#!/bin/sh
# Long-running inventory worker: periodically snapshots basic host inventory
# facts into /var/lib/inventory. Confined by bwrap to write only there.
set -eu

OUT_DIR="/var/lib/inventory"
STATE_FILE="$OUT_DIR/state.json"
LOG_FILE="$OUT_DIR/worker.log"

echo "inventory-worker starting, pid $$" >> "$LOG_FILE"

i=0
while true; do
  i=$((i + 1))
  ts=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
  {
    printf '{'
    printf '"iteration":%d,' "$i"
    printf '"timestamp":"%s",' "$ts"
    printf '"hostname":"%s",' "$(hostname)"
    printf '"uptime":"%s"' "$(cat /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1)"
    printf '}\n'
  } > "$STATE_FILE.tmp"
  mv "$STATE_FILE.tmp" "$STATE_FILE"
  echo "$ts iteration=$i wrote $STATE_FILE" >> "$LOG_FILE"
  sleep 5
done
EOF
